w2k.experiment.blackbox_command_line_laf: Instructs the Blackbox to override the theme it uses when launching the game with one defined in the command-line Java option "me.videogamesm12.w2k.blackbox_theme" if set.
w2k.experiment.blackbox_default_laf_base: Changes the behavior of the Blackbox when setting up a fresh installation to use a theme based on the system you're using and how it's configured instead of defaulting to a Material Dark theme.
w2k.experiment.blackbox_help_window.name: Knowledge Base in Blackbox
w2k.experiment.blackbox_help_window.desc: A new feature in the Blackbox which allows users to open a window containing offline documentation about W2K, its components, and some useful tips.
